page_title: BRE 0-3 PSG | Brest v PSG 25/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+7' Jeremie Pignard sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
90+7' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The PSG players aren’t happy.
90+6' 0 - 3 Warren Zaire-Emery feeds the ball through to Desire Doue (PSG), who picks up the pass inside the box and quickly drills it into the roof of the net! The goalkeeper was helpless. 0:3!
90+3' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Desire Doue (PSG) takes it short.
90+2' We are about to witness a subsitution. Luc Zogbe (Brest) for Romain Del Castillo.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Desire Doue (PSG) latches onto a pass inside the box, steps inside his marker and smacks a shot against the left post. The ball goes out of play and Brest will have a goal kick.
88' Lucas Chevalier pulls off a great save to deny Mama Balde (Brest) who, makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive towards the middle of the goal.
87' Now PSG have a corner.
86' Ball possession – 26:74.
82' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Romain Del Castillo (Brest) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
79' The substitution has been made. Quentin Ndjantou (PSG) has replaced Senny Mayulu.
79' Substitution. Bradley Barcola walks off the pitch and Goncalo Ramos (PSG) comes on as a substitute.
78' Eric Roy prepares a substitution. Bradley Locko is replaced by Daouda Guindo (Brest).
78' Substitution. Hugo Magnetti leaves the pitch and is replaced by Hamidou Makalou (Brest).
77' A player from Brest commits a rough challenge. Jeremie Pignard blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
76' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top. The ball goes out of play and Brest will have a goal kick.
73' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
72' PSG seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
70' Luis Enrique decides to make a substitution. Khvicha Kvaratskhelia will be replaced by Desire Doue (PSG).
67' Pathe Mboup comes off the pitch to be replaced by Mama Balde (Brest).
67' Here's the change. Junior Dina Ebimbe leaves the pitch and Lucas Tousart (Brest) comes on as a substitute.
66' Willian Pacho (PSG) goes off the pitch and Marquinhos comes on.
66' That will be all from Kang-In Lee who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Ousmane Dembele (PSG).
66' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Radoslaw Majecki pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
65' Kang-In Lee (PSG) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
65' Good defending. Achraf Hakimi (PSG) tries to find Bradley Barcola inside the box, but the pass is cut out. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to PSG.
63' Kang-In Lee (PSG) shoots from distance but it's wayward and goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brest.
63' Great teamplay by PSG as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
61' A cross by Kenny Lala (Brest) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
59' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) misses the penalty! His poor effort goes well over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for PSG.
59' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
58' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!
57' Referee Jeremie Pignard makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
53' Surely that's handball by one of the PSG players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
51' Brest are ruled offside.
49' Vitinha (PSG) and Achraf Hakimi combine well with a quick one-two to trick their opponent.
47' PSG enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle.
40' PSG control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
39' 0 - 2 Goal - 0:2! Khvicha Kvaratskhelia laid the ball off to Achraf Hakimi (PSG), who shot from close range into the top right corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
37' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play. PSG will have a throw-in.
33' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) hits a piledriver from long range, but the effort curls well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and PSG will have a goal kick.
32' PSG quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
29' 0 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Vitinha plays it into the box, and Achraf Hakimi (PSG) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the bottom left corner. 0:1.
27' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
25' The ratio of the ball possession is 21:79.
25' Jeremie Pignard shows a yellow card to Pathe Mboup (Brest) for his blatant foul.

24' Senny Mayulu (PSG) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the right side of the goal. However, Radoslaw Majecki anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
23' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to PSG.
23' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
22' The ball goes out of play. PSG are awarded a corner kick.

20' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending. The ball is behind the touchline and PSG will take a throw-in.
19' Michel Diaz Jr. (Brest) was too forceful with his tackle and Jeremie Pignard interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
17' Pathe Mboup (Brest) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Lucas Chevalier makes a great save.
17' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
15' The corner from Romain Del Castillo (Brest) is cleared away by the defence.
14' Bradley Barcola (PSG) attempts to find Achraf Hakimi, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brest.
12' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Brest) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
11' PSG are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
9' There's an opportunity for Romain Del Castillo (Brest) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
8' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
7' Vitinha (PSG) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
6' Rough tackle by Kang-In Lee (PSG). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
3' Neat passing move from PSG in order to create new attacking opportunities.
2' The free kick from long range, taken by Brest, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
2' Jeremie Pignard blows the whistle, Vitinha (PSG) is penalised for a foul.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Brest will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Jeremie Pignard.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
